# find_aromatic_cycles_in_sgraph { #mofography.analyze.find_aromatic_cycles_in_sgraph }

`analyze.find_aromatic_cycles_in_sgraph(sgraph, default_ring_sizes=[5, 6, 7, 8, 9])`

> Find all cycles in the graph, then find all cycles that are composed of double bonds, then find
all unique cycles, then find all isomorphic cycles. 

The function returns a list of lists, where each list contains the indices of the atoms in the
aromatic cycle. 

Let's try it out on our example molecule:

## Parameters

| Name                 | Type   | Description                                               | Default           |
|----------------------|--------|-----------------------------------------------------------|-------------------|
| `sgraph`             |        | The graph object that you want to find aromatic cycles in | _required_        |
| `default_ring_sizes` |        | The ring sizes to consider                                | `[5, 6, 7, 8, 9]` |

## Returns

| Type   | Description                                                |
|--------|------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | A list of lists of nodes that are part of aromatic cycles. |
